args: This is a new, separate call in an investigation of a two-player board game whose rules are not shown. You have no memory of the earlier call; do not assume any. Open the page at the given URL, then open revision.html. It lists, in full, every form submitted in the earlier call of this investigation: each statement, confidence, cited evidence, structured representation (or that none was given) and abstention. It may also list recorded observations that differ from what those structured hypotheses predict. The observation pages and hypothesis.html are the same as in the earlier call. For each listed hypothesis you may keep it (do nothing), submit a revision (a new form whose "Revises" field names its H-number), or withdraw it (an abstention whose "Revises" field names its H-number). Forms that name no H-number are new hypotheses. The earlier submissions are kept in every case. Report only what the observations support. Submit at most 8 forms.
